name: Add Text Annotation
description:
Add a text annotation to an ActivInspire flipchart.

Your task:
1. Create a new flipchart in ActivInspire (File > New Flipchart or Ctrl+N)
2. Select the Text tool from the toolbar (usually shows as 'T' or 'Text' icon)
3. Click on the flipchart canvas to place text
4. Type the following text: 'Welcome to Today's Lesson'
5. The text should be visible on the flipchart page
6. Save the flipchart to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/lesson_with_text.flipchart' (File > Save As or Ctrl+Shift+S)

Note: There is no pre-existing flipchart - you must create a new one first. The text tool is typically found in the main toolbar. After selecting it, click where you want the text to appear and start typing.
